data.name: Habitation Grande Anse
data.description:
Set in a series of low-rise buildings surrounded by landscaped tropical gardens, this relaxed apartment hotel is a 10-minute walk from Grande Anse Beach and 39 km from downtown Pointe-à-Pitre.
Warmly decorated studios with balconies or terraces come with cane furniture, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi and kitchens. Some offer bunk beds and/or sea views, and there are 1- and 2-bedroom apartments; the latter have mezzanine sleeping areas.
Breakfast (surcharge) is served in a Creole/international restaurant that also offers a dinner service in high season. Gardens include a pool with sunloungers. Pets are welcome, and parking is complimentary.
